## Motivation

A pool with several sliding-window sub-pools reported one window: pool stats, scheduler stats and the Prometheus series each had a single `swa_*` slot, filled from whichever window was called "swa". Further windows went unreported, and the bottleneck usage and busy log ignored them.

## Modifications

- `managers/scheduler_components/pool_stats_observer.py`: `SubPoolUsage` carries a family (`full`, `window`, `mamba`) and a label; `PoolStats.windows` lists one `WindowPoolStats` per window in the prefix tree's window order, each with evictable tokens read from its own tree slot. `token_usage`, `num_used_tokens` and the prefill/decode log lines cover every window.
- `observability/metrics_collector.py`, `metrics_reporter.py`: `SchedulerStats` holds per-window maps, published with a `window` label.
- `managers/scheduler_components/memory_usage.py`, `rust/sglang-server/src/api_server/http/info.rs`, `src/message/info.rs`: server info reports `memory_usage.token_capacity_window`, a map from window name to its capacity.
- `invariant_checker.py`: the busy and idle leak checks conserve the tree's first window (further windows are checked by a later PR in this stack).
- Every window is named the way a unified pool names its window sub-pool (`window_<length>`, or `window` when the length is unstated); a static pool's single window gets the same name from its window length.
- Tests: `test/registered/unit/observability/test_window_pool_metrics.py` (new), updates to `test_prealloc_token_usage.py`, `test_stat_loggers_di.py`, `test_forward_pass_metrics.py`, `test_invariant_checker.py`, `test/registered/core/test_srt_endpoint.py`.

**Behavior change (public metrics and API, no compatibility alias):**
- Removed: `sglang:swa_token_usage`, `sglang:swa_available_tokens`, `sglang:swa_evictable_tokens`, `sglang:swa_used_tokens`, `sglang:prealloc_swa_token_usage`, `sglang:max_total_num_tokens_swa`.
- Added, each with a `window` label (`window="window_<len>"`): `sglang:window_token_usage`, `sglang:window_available_tokens`, `sglang:window_evictable_tokens`, `sglang:window_used_tokens`, `sglang:prealloc_window_token_usage`, `sglang:max_total_num_tokens_window`.
- `/server_info` `memory_usage.token_capacity_swa` is replaced by `memory_usage.token_capacity_window` (a map by window name).
- This applies to static SWA pools as well as unified memory; dashboards and alerts reading the `swa` series need updating.

## Accuracy Tests

Serving validation was run at the **top of this 26-PR stack** (the cumulative change), not at this PR's head. Software: torch 2.14.1+cu130, flashinfer 0.7.2, sglang-kernel 0.4.10. GSM8K is few-shot, 500 or 1319 questions as noted; `main` is the same commit the stack is based on, same flags.

| Hardware | Model | Configuration | Stack top | main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, `--enable-unified-memory` (rebased stack) | 0.954 (1319 q) | 0.950–0.954 |
| 1x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP1, `--enable-unified-memory --max-total-tokens 120000` (rebased stack) | 0.842 (1319 q) | 0.839 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, MTP (EAGLE, 3 steps, topk 1, 4 draft tokens) | 0.951, accept length 3.56 | 0.953, 3.56 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, DFlash draft | 0.951, accept length 5.42 | 0.952, 5.44 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PD (prefill TP1 + decode TP1, mooncake), unified, repeated runs | 0.952–0.960, no hang | 0.954–0.958 |
| 2x H200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | PD (TP1 + TP1, mooncake), unified | 0.810 | 0.808 |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified, HiCache | 0.954 | — |
| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | PP2, unified | 0.953 | 0.955 (static pools) |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | TP2, unified (500 q) | 0.958 | 0.960 |
| 2x B200 | openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified, `trtllm_mha` (1319 q) | 0.849 | 0.863 |
| 2x B300 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B / openai/gpt-oss-120b | TP2, unified | 0.950 / 0.849 | 0.954 / 0.849 |

On B200 and B300, 40 greedy GSM8K generations were compared with `main`: 35–40 of 40 are identical, and the rest first differ after at least 27 characters (near ties). The H200 runs above other than the two marked "rebased stack" were run at the stack top before it was rebased onto the current base; the code they cover is unchanged by the rebase except for conflict resolutions.

Serving accuracy is unaffected by metric naming; the unit tests above check the series, labels and server-info fields.

Per-window maps replace scalar fields in stats collection; no measurable change expected. Measured at the stack top, same flags as `main` (bench_serving, random 4096-in / 512-out unless noted):

|---|---|---|---|

| 2x H200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B MTP TP2 / DFlash TP2 | 4.26 / 4.36 req/s | 4.29 / 4.35 req/s |
| 2x B200 | Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B TP2 / openai/gpt-oss-120b TP2 | 6.35 / 19.31 req/s | 6.34 / 19.28 req/s |

+"""Every sliding-window KV pool reports its usage under its own window name,
+unified pools with several windows and static pools with one alike."""
+
+import unittest
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import prometheus_client
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components.pool_stats_observer import (
+    SchedulerPoolStatsObserver,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv.storage import SubPoolUsage
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.static_kv_storage import StaticKVStorage, StaticPoolShape
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.component_type import ComponentType
+from sglang.srt.observability.metrics_collector import (
+    SchedulerMetricsCollector,
+    SchedulerStats,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+# Three window slots of the prefix tree and the sub-pool behind each, the
+# tree's first window first.
+_SLOTS = {
+    ComponentType.SWA: "window_128",
+    "second window slot": "window_64",
+    "third window slot": "window_32",
+}
+
+
+def _usage(name, metrics, capacity, available):
+    return SubPoolUsage(
+        name=name, metrics=metrics, label=name, capacity=capacity, available=available
+    )
+
+
+def _three_window_observer():
+    # The storage lists sub-pools owner first, not in the tree's window order.
+    storage = SimpleNamespace(
+        usage=lambda: (
+            _usage("full", "full", 1000, 600),
+            _usage("window_32", "window", 100, 40),
+            _usage("window_64", "window", 200, 120),
+            _usage("window_128", "window", 400, 100),
+        ),
+        tree_sub_pool=lambda slot: _SLOTS[slot],
+    )
+    evictable = {"window_128": 100, "window_64": 30, "window_32": 10}
+    tree_cache = SimpleNamespace(
+        window_slots=lambda: tuple(_SLOTS),
+        window_evictable_size=lambda slot: evictable[_SLOTS[slot]],
+        full_evictable_size=lambda: 150,
+    )
+    return SchedulerPoolStatsObserver(
+        tree_cache=tree_cache,
+        storage=storage,
+        token_to_kv_pool_allocator=SimpleNamespace(),
+        session_controller=None,
+        hisparse_coordinator=None,
+        enable_hisparse=False,
+    )
+
+
+def _collector(registry):
+    with (
+        mock.patch("sglang.srt.observability.metrics_collector.GaugeHistogram"),
+        mock.patch(
+            "sglang.srt.observability.metrics_collector.get_schedule",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                prefill_delayer_max_delay_passes=10,
+                prefill_delayer_forward_passes_buckets=None,
+                prefill_delayer_wait_seconds_buckets=None,
+            ),
+        ),
+        mock.patch(
+            "prometheus_client.Gauge",
+            partial(prometheus_client.Gauge, registry=registry),
+        ),
+        mock.patch(
+            "prometheus_client.Counter",
+            partial(prometheus_client.Counter, registry=registry),
+        ),
+        mock.patch(
+            "prometheus_client.Histogram",
+            partial(prometheus_client.Histogram, registry=registry),
+        ),
+    ):
+        return SchedulerMetricsCollector(
+            labels={"model_name": "test", "moe_ep_rank": 1}, server_args=None
+        )
+
+
+class TestWindowPoolMetrics(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_three_windows_report_three_label_values(self):
+        stats = _three_window_observer().get_pool_stats()
+        # The tree's first window comes first, whatever the storage order.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [w.name for w in stats.windows], ["window_128", "window_64", "window_32"]
+        )
+        by_name = {w.name: w for w in stats.windows}
+        self.assertEqual(by_name["window_128"].num_used, 400 - (100 + 100))
+        self.assertEqual(by_name["window_64"].num_used, 200 - (120 + 30))
+        self.assertEqual(by_name["window_32"].num_used, 100 - (40 + 10))
+        self.assertEqual(by_name["window_64"].token_usage, 50 / 200)
+        # The bottleneck runs over every window.
+        self.assertEqual(stats.get_max_pool_usage(), 0.5)
+        self.assertEqual(stats.get_kv_token_stats(), (250, 0.5))
+
+        scheduler_stats = SchedulerStats()
+        stats.update_scheduler_stats(scheduler_stats)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            scheduler_stats.window_used_tokens,
+            {"window_128": 200, "window_64": 50, "window_32": 50},
+        )
+        registry = prometheus_client.CollectorRegistry()
+        _collector(registry).log_stats(scheduler_stats)
+        samples = {
+            (sample.name, sample.labels.get("window")): sample.value
+            for family in registry.collect()
+            for sample in family.samples
+            if sample.name.startswith("sglang:window_")
+        }
+        for name, window in by_name.items():
+            self.assertEqual(
+                samples[("sglang:window_token_usage", name)], window.token_usage
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                samples[("sglang:window_available_tokens", name)],
+                window.available_size,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                samples[("sglang:window_evictable_tokens", name)],
+                window.evictable_size,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                samples[("sglang:window_used_tokens", name)], window.num_used
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(len(samples), 4 * 3)
+        self.assertNotIn(
+            "sglang:swa_token_usage",
+            {family.name for family in registry.collect()},
+        )
+
+    def test_logs_name_each_window(self):
+        parts = _three_window_observer().get_pool_stats().get_decode_usage_msg_parts()
+        for name in ("window_128", "window_64", "window_32"):
+            self.assertIn(f"#{name} token: ", " ".join(parts))
+            self.assertIn(f"{name} token usage: ", " ".join(parts))
+
+    def test_window_capacity_constant_per_window(self):
+        registry = prometheus_client.CollectorRegistry()
+        _collector(registry).emit_constants(
+            max_total_num_tokens=1000,
+            max_total_num_tokens_window={"window_128": 400, "window_64": 400},
+            weight_memory_usage_gb=0.0,
+            kv_cache_memory_usage_gb=0.0,
+            graph_memory_usage_gb={},
+            max_running_requests_under_SLO=None,
+            page_size=1,
+            num_pages=1000,
+            context_len=128,
+            startup_available_gpu_memory_gb=0.0,
+        )
+        samples = {
+            sample.labels.get("window"): sample.value
+            for family in registry.collect()
+            for sample in family.samples
+            if sample.name == "sglang:max_total_num_tokens_window"
+        }
+        self.assertEqual(samples, {"window_128": 400, "window_64": 400})
+
+    def test_static_single_window_reports_its_length_name(self):
+        allocator = SimpleNamespace(
+            swa_capacity_and_available=lambda full_capacity, swa_capacity: (
+                (full_capacity, 700),
+                (swa_capacity, 90),
+            )
+        )
+        storage = StaticKVStorage(
+            None,
+            allocator,
+            shape=StaticPoolShape(
+                has_window=True,
+                has_state=False,
+                token_capacity=1000,
+                full_tokens_per_layer=1000,
+                swa_tokens_per_layer=200,
+                window=4096,
+            ),
+        )
+        (full, window) = storage.usage()
+        self.assertEqual((full.metrics, full.label), ("full", "full"))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            (window.metrics, window.label, window.capacity, window.available),
+            ("window", "window_4096", 200, 90),
+        )
+
